_what: MAP's credit recommendations per course at the harvest's nine colleges (the pilot's five, Santa Monica, Irvine Valley, Moreno Valley and Norco): how many credit recommendations and exhibits MAP holds against each course code, and the exhibit titles behind them. Counts and credential titles only; no student column is read or carried. The ROEP display builder (kb/_build_roep_display.py) reads it as the 'articulated here' kind beside the CER's industry-credential lines.
_source: public.map_college_cr_unit (reviewer-gated) joined to map_colleges by college_id; exhibit titles from map_ace_exhibit_titles, else chatbox_exhibits. A college_course string naming several courses ('ADJ-13 ...(3.0), ADJ-19 ...(3.0)') counts toward each course it names. Course code = the SUBJ-NUM token with the hyphen read as a space.
_read_by: SkyFern (S358) through the Supabase MCP: Moreno Valley (106 course codes) and Norco (82) added; Riverside City re-read in full and equal to the 2026-10-06 read on all 34 codes (md5 feff937a5b5c8320029a06ab06a97243). Earlier: SkyLedger (S340) through the Supabase MCP. Santa Monica and Irvine Valley were read in full. The pilot's five were proved against the 2026-10-04 read by a fingerprint per course; the four courses that differed (Riverside MAG 51; West LA AVIATEK 002, 005 and 017: one exhibit title each, and one credit recommendation fewer on AVIATEK 002) were re-read. Every college's fingerprint matches the live read.
_refresh: By hand, the way kb/ccr_cpl_funnel.json is refreshed: run kb/program_requirements_pilot/map_cr_by_course.sql through the Supabase MCP when the funnel reloads (map-custom-report-load.yml) or the harvest adds a college, and file the rows here.
